notes: "HUANDENG did not start from nothing. The editor is built on OpenSlide, under the MIT licence. Equation conversion reuses code from the OpenPPTD repository; the GitHub mark here identifies that repository, it is not an OpenPPTD logo. PowerPoint export uses PptxGenJS. On the right are things HUANDENG does not do yet, as listed in the project README: importing arbitrary PPTX files and round-tripping them, editing Google Slides directly, a separate presenter window on a second screen, inheritable slide masters, native PowerPoint animation in exported files, and a plugin marketplace. If you need one of these, that is where a contribution would help most."

designIntent.purpose: Credit code foundations and list the gaps documented in the README.
keep: GitHub mark identifies the OpenPPTD repository only
